options.text: Stage 1 '可以' Stage 2 '下次我请你'

Stage 1 '这次不行' Stage 2 '别再问了'

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: declining and offering a future invitation is the soft refusal pattern; the distractors shut down, contradict, or omit the follow-up. On that basis "Stage 1 '这次不行' Stage 2 '下次我请你" is the supported choice. Option A ("Stage 1 '可以' Stage 2 '下次我请你") fails because it accepts then offers follow-up, contradicting; Option C ("Stage 1 '这次不行' Stage 2 '别再问了") fails because it declines then shuts down; Option D ("Stage 1 '这次不行' Stage 2 '没别的了") fails because it declines without follow-up.
